links.outcome: Strict NDR accuracy of frontier proprietary models versus a 15-endoscopist clinician panel
links.effect: Best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy; clinician panel baseline is 78% strict accuracy on 1,500 questions.
links.quote: On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing multi-turn evaluation protocol isolating per-turn reasoning from cascading dialogue errors
Deterministic instantiation of benchmark questions from clinician-filled structured EHR reports rather than synthetic or LLM-rephrased annotations

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates multimodal foundation models on a new benchmark (EndoSCOP-V) for multi-turn video understanding and clinical reasoning in endoscopy reporting, compared to human clinician baselines.
